$comment: Uploading a file to the network's own filehost, shared by tests/shared/filehost.test.ts and the Android SharedCorpusTest. The desktop has had this since there was a file picker; the phone had no attach button at all, which is the wrong way round — a photograph is on the phone.
$where: `isupport` is what the network advertised; `url` is where uploads go, or null.

where.name: the draft spelling, which plenty of servers still send
a token with nothing in it
something that is not a URL
a scheme that is not http

$auth: Whether the account password may be sent. The upload authenticates with Basic, which over plain http hands the password to anyone on the path — and unlike the IRC connection, this URL is whatever the server said.
$resolved: What the filehost answered with, and the link that goes in the channel. The draft allows a relative Location, and a relative one pasted into a channel is a link to nothing.

resolved.name: an absolute URL is used as it is
a relative one is resolved against the filehost
a bare name is resolved too
surrounding space is not part of it
a Location that is not a link to a file at all
nor is one that reads this machine
